figurative_meaning_en: Sanskrit-laden Bengali language, stiff or pedantic Bengali speech
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পণ্ডিতি ভাষা শুনে কেউ বুঝতে পারে না।
সভায় সবাই সাধারণ ভাষায় কথা বলুন, পণ্ডিতি ভাষা এড়িয়ে চলুন।
example_sentences_in_english: No one can understand his pedantic language.
Speak in plain terms at the meeting, avoid that stiff scholarly speech.
note: Refers to the cultural practice in Bengal of incorporating Sanskrit words into Bengali for formal or elevated expression, often seen as overly complex.
